lines: Aoi's voice lines and sound effects.
- "Need new music? I'm your gal. Got the latest and greatest, oldies and goldies. And some other stuff too."
- "Wouldn't kill you to have a little fun, Arthur!"
- "C'mon, Eleanor. Do that synaesthesia thing again."
- "You can shut me out all you want, Lettie, but in the end I'm gonna make friends with you 'til you beg for mercy."
- "So, Quincy, is there a reason you always have the air of someone attending their own funeral? Pfeh. What is it with the hot ones?"
- "I get that we're here for the common good, but losing music, clubs, dancing... That sucks crud through three miles of crazy straw."
- "Old stuff, new stuff, I've got it all."
- "What are we thinking? Dance? Moody? Pop?"
- "Hey, hey, check this out. Just came in."
- "(Singing) Oh! Hey! Didn't see you there. Heh."
- "Flip through the stacks, take your time."
- "Let me know if you need a hand."
- "What are you in the mood for?"
- "Need a little something to lift your day?"
- "I've been listening to this one track on repeat for days."
- "A world without music. Can you imagine? I'm so glad we managed to save this stuff."
- "If things ever get back to normal, first thing? A year at music festivals."
- "Hey, c'mon! This is the good stuff!"
- "Let me know, maybe I can get something in."
- "Okay. Oh! Could you check if Amir got the smoothie machine working?"
- "Okay. Gonna see if maybe Arthur wants to go for a run."
- "Wow. Have you done something with your look?"
- "Weird, I was just listening to this track and it reminded me of you... What's the latest?"
- "Oh? Like, I can update my status?"
- "Well, YES! Yes and Yes. This is what I wanted. Yes, let's start as us."
- "All right, but um... can you please never do that to me again?"
- "Go away then. Did Arthur put you up to this? This is low even for him."
- "It's not that I don't think we'd be a great couple, I'm just... I'm just really not ready. I need to be able to say no and have you understand, okay?"
- "I didn't think I'd be hearing this. I - I don't think I can hate you but, I just, please leave me alone for a second."
- "I... I really think you should walk away from me right now, thank you."
- "If you're joking, it's not funny. Don't do this yo-yoing, okay?"
- "Oh? Like, I can update my status?"
- "Hey, baby. Let me turn this off. So what's the latest?"
- "If it isn't the best looking time traveler in the place."
- "Hey. Thanks for last night. How's the day?"
- "Ooh, hey, I found this track, it is definitely you."
- "Or maybe you're gonna bail on us, Arthur? Forget it."
- "Arthur! What the hell was that? Where are you? Come in!"
- "So you just puppet this thing? Whole lot of metal in there..."
- "Arthur's taking a chance on you. You hurt him, and I'll twist you inside out. Try not to scratch the paint."
- "Right, we're the terrorists. Love what you've done with the place, lady."
- "You don't have a problem with a few hundred thousand going up in smoke?"
- "Isn't it great? Amir got these from the hack!"
- "We got chatter on Scaldra comms! They've been moving a V.I.P. at regular intervals. It's gotta be Dr. E, right? Meet me across town."
- "Convoy approaching the Mehra Tunnels. That's the place to hit them."
- "I'm just a pretty face, Arthur. Oh sh-"
- "Still not used to... whatever this is. Here. Let's ditch the cycles for something less... conspicuous."
- "Five of us. Arthur, maybe it is time to bail."
- "What do you want me to do?"
- "Arthur! I can't! I can't! Arthur! Ar-!"
- "What do you want me to do?"
- "Arthur! I can't! I can't! Arthur! Ar-!"
- "Right here by your side. Now and always."
- "Hope you don't mind - I rearranged some cables! Tidy space, tidy mind."
- "There's SO much gold in here. Let's pretend we're royalty! *ahem* Princess Aoi, your highness."
- "Don't forget to safely turn off your computer before bed, Ok?"
- "I tried on those Archwings of yours, ya know, they do grip tight in the hips. If you ever felt like... nevermind."
- "Maybe I hid a crane somewhere? Maybe I didn't. Maybe I hid... two?"
- "Wishing for anything? I could grant you something nice if you have just a few minutes."
- "Don't laugh, but this? I think this is the happiest I've ever been."
- "Sunscreen, please! There's no proof you're immune to sunburn, is there? Let's not find out."
- "I hope it's not bothering you that I leave some lights on at night, it's - it's just a thing I've always done, and..."
- "I downloaded us a movie for later... wanna chill?"
- "I know Amir could probably get a pizza here fastest, but watching Lettie try not to steal a bite on the way here would be much more fun!"
- "You can hear the Helminth too right? Not just me? Does it ever sleep?"
- "I promise you'll never lose the remote, I can isolate it and just YOINK!"
- "Do you think we should get everyone to pick some songs? I can burn a CD!"
- "I wish we could have more pets. More everything, really."
- "It's not too bad, is it? Being here like this?"
- "It's like every choice in my life led me to you. Thank you life!"
- "If you can't hear a balloon pop from the mall, think of what they can't hear from us in here."
- "It's soundproof in here, right? Oh I hope so."
- "I always wanted my own space to decorate!"
- "That gold is real. I checked. Maybe I could, hm, make some handcuffs?"
- "I wonder if Eleanor and Lettie would be up for a movie night. A chick flick would be so fun! Amir can come too."
- "We're lucky that couch is strong, aren't we."
- "I was on the internet and and I - I found this website with a few images that gave me some ideas for later."
- "Feeling this safe, feeling this secure, it isn't something that I expected for me. But I'm glad."

- "Being able to look up and see the world beyond the glass, it feels like we're in a safe pocket of something comfortable. I love looking out there and knowing I can turn around and look here, at you."
- "I just never want anyone to fight over any of this. I love us, I love you, and I love my friends. That's my happiness."
- "I know it's embarrassing, but I have to ask if you think I'm a good kisser. I just feel like I never want to stop, but I - I don't want to overwhelm you. Is that okay?"
- "If you can, can you bring me a mixtape? From the future? I want to feel the music you feel."
- "I just hope I get to see live music one day. Getting lost in a crowd with you would be the type of memory that makes my heart beat faster and faster."
- "Do you think the mannequins out there have a better butt than me? Think carefully."
- I've tried to make things other than cranes but they just end up looking wrong. I wonder if cranes just come naturally because they mate for life."
- "One thing I will say is that I haven't had a zit since this all happened. I do miss the pop, but I don't miss the eyesore."
- "My teeth are feeling a bit sharper, I think, I'm not sure if it's in my head. If I end up like Eleanor, can I bite you?"
- "Me too, I'd be even more glad if we were more together over there on that couch."
- "Aww, you're just saying that because you need me to fix your Tommy again, aren't you."
- "I am so happy you said that. I feel the same way, and I also just feel worried sick when you're not here so come back, okay?"
- "Me too, I was thinking maybe it'd be nice to watch the sunrise soon? Just lay under a techrot canopy and count the stars beyond before the sun hides them for another day?"
- "Let's take care of each other, let's make this together something that can't be taken away."
- "Oh me too, me too. I just don't ever want to hurt you because of what I am now, my hugs can be a bit, well, intense?"
- In Japanese: "I love you forever, my crane."
- "I know, you're busy, we're all busy."
> It's traditional to kiss your beloved on New Year's Eve for luck. The Hex need all the luck they can get, so we ought to do a lot of kissing, don't you agree?
> They're counting on us! Don't be late!
- "A lifetime of being charmed by you. Sign me up."
- "Anytime I hear any countdown, I'll blush. Thinking of this. Us."
- "How did I get so lucky, so spoiled."

- "Metal, metal, metal, what do you want to be?"
- "I don't wanna go on patrol. I wanna take stuff apart."
- "If they take Entrati out, who's going to look after that mutant jaguar of his? Poor thing won't last five minutes in the wild."
- "GodDAMN. Lettie, would you keep your frickin' rats OUT of my SPACE?"
- "Arthur needs to keep some fuel in the tank for himself. Goddamn savior complex that man has..."

- "Civvies ringing the alarm all over the KIM network: Scaldra's started a neighborhood purge and the locals got nowhere to run. What do you think? Time for a purge of our own?"
- "Scaldra purge-squad just moved into the area. They're putting down anything that moves, infested and civilians alike. How's about we return the favor? I'm talking total wipeout."
- "Scaldra's systematically pumping Efervon through this neighborhood. Not good for anything with a pulse, including civvies. Only way to stop them is to put them down first."
- "Techrot's just the excuse. Scaldra is using these purges as cover to kill anyone who won't follow their orders. I say we send them a message and wipe out this entire purge squad."

- "There's barely any Techrot in the area. This is purely a civilian purge. Clearing out locals so that the Scaldra loyal can move in? Ugh, I hate Scaldra. "

- "Okay squad, you are the biggest, baddest warriors under Sol. You're gonna go out there and you're gonna be faster than lightning. And then the lightning will make us a pizza."
- "Ick. Nasty Techrot baddies up ahead. Do me a favor, and take out the trash."

- "A Mobile Voice broadcast balloon has been discovered and is taking damage. Get there and provide support. This city deserves better than unrelenting Scaldra propaganda."
- "A Mobile Voice broadcast broadcast balloon is under attack. Help them. This one's personal. Music is everything."
- "That's the Mobile Voice balloon. Keep it clear of all attackers and bust up any signal jammers you find to keep it moving."
- "Hey, you found the balloon. Keep it safe, and smash any signal jammers. I do not want to go back to listening to Viktor droning on all day."
- "Jammers nearby! The sooner you take them out, the sooner Mobile Voice will be safe. "
- "Stay on top of those jammers, squad."
- "Balloon's taken too much damage. It's doing its recovery mode thing. Smashing jammers will hurry it up."

- "Pump up the volume. We are coming in crystal clear all across Höllvania. Well done."
